text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Emir praises achievements by Bahrain Petroleum Company over the past 60 years. The company spent $50 million this year on upgrades.
- U.S. ambassador to Bahrain briefs foreign minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Mubarak al-Khalifa on the situation in northern Iraq and U.S. measures taken so far.
- Bahrain backs bid to protect environment. More than 50 experts due to discuss action plan.
- Paksitan is expected to give formal approval before the end of the year for a proposed Pakistan trade centre in Bahrain.
